environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private VPC subnet. Container runs as root. The internal ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following configuration: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'internal-traversal-guard' with priority 1 containing a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching '(?:(?:\.\.[\\/])|(?:[\\/]etc[\\/])|(?:[\\/]proc[\\/])|(?:[\\/]var[\\/](?!data[\\/]exports)))' with BLOCK action and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE applied twice followed by NORMALIZE_PATH, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The Kafka topic has a custom authorizer that restricts producer access to a single service account (export-request-svc) which validates message payloads against a JSON schema requiring filePath to match '^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-/]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$' before publishing. The container's ECS task role has no S3 or Secrets Manager permissions.
